Additionally, the person helped the woman up and apologized afterward, which shows some remorse. But the initial action was still wrong. The gut reaction doesn't excuse the use of offensive language.

So, considering all this, the action was morally unacceptable. The person used derogatory language towards someone, which is disrespectful and hurtful, even if they didn't realize the person was blind at the time.
